name: BLIFFERT RES (KYLE)
address: 1814 NW WILD RYE CIRCLE, BEND, OR 97703

fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responding units locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the driveway so emergency vehicles can travel the full length without obstruction.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence and detached structure without delay.
• Clear a walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings on foot.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the sides and rear of the property to give responders a clear path around the buildings.
• Mark or label the detached structure so arriving units can identify it as a separate building from the road or driveway.
• Keep any gate or barrier at the single driveway entrance unlocked or equipped with a Knox Box so responders are not delayed at the property entrance.
• Maintain the open lawn area free of stored equipment or materials so it remains available as a staging area for emergency personnel and equipment.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang directly over or within a few feet of the structure's roof and walls.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create gaps between individual tree canopies.
• Remove dead branches and dry ground vegetation from beneath scattered trees near the structure.
• Clear ground vegetation growing directly against the base of the structure on all sides.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along its full length.
• Maintain the open terrain areas between the structure and surrounding trees by keeping ground vegetation mowed short.
• Separate any wood piles, outdoor furniture, or other stored materials from the structure and move them away from tree clusters.
• Thin low branches on scattered trees close to the structure to reduce the ability of ground fire to climb into the tree canopy.
